arxiv-2105-00527.title: Flow-induced flapping of an inverted flag with non-uniform stiffness distribution
arxiv-2105-00527.creator: Andres Goza 1
arxiv-2105-00527.description: Abstract We perform high-fidelity, two-dimensional (2D), fluid-structure interaction (FSI) simulations at a Reynolds number of R ​ e = 200 Re=200 of uniform flow past an inverted flag (i.e., clamped at its trailing edge). The inverted flag system can exhibit large-amplitude flapping motions (on the order of the flag length) that can be converted to electricity via, e.g., piezoelectric materials.

arxiv-2106-11773.title: A Survey on Serverless Computing
arxiv-2106-11773.creator: Jacob John, Shashank Gupta
arxiv-2106-11773.description: Abstract The Internet is responsible for accelerating growth in several fields such as digital media, healthcare, the military. Furthermore, the Internet was founded on the principle of allowing clients to communicating with servers. However, serverless computing is one such field that tries to break free from this paradigm.

arxiv-2109-06680.title: Polynomial decompositions with invariance and positivity inspired by tensors
arxiv-2109-06680.creator: Gemma De las Cuevas, Andreas Klingler, Tim Netzer
arxiv-2109-06680.description: Abstract . We present a framework to decompose real multivariate polynomials while preserving invariance and positivity. This framework has been recently introduced for tensor decompositions, in particular for quantum many-body systems. Here we transfer results about decomposition structures, invariance under permutations of variables, positivity, rank inequalities and separations, approximations, and undecidability to real polynomials.

arxiv-2112-14737.title: Distance-Aware Private Set Intersection
arxiv-2112-14737.creator: Anrin Chakraborti, Giulia Fanti, Michael K. Reiter
arxiv-2112-14737.description: Abstract Private set intersection (PSI) allows two mutually untrusting parties to compute an intersection of their sets, without revealing information about items that are not in the intersection. This work introduces a PSI variant called distance-aware PSI (DA-PSI) for sets whose elements lie in a metric space.

arxiv-2403-04429.title: Exploring the Influence of Dimensionality Reduction on Anomaly Detection Performance in Multivariate Time Series
arxiv-2403-04429.creator: Mahsun Altin, Altan Cakir
arxiv-2403-04429.description: Abstract This paper presents an extensive empirical study on the integration of dimensionality reduction techniques with advanced unsupervised time series anomaly detection models, focusing on the MUTANT and Anomaly-Transformer models. The study involves a comprehensive evaluation across three different datasets: MSL, SMAP, and SWaT.

arxiv-2405-14435.title: High-Level Event Mining: Overview and Future Work
arxiv-2405-14435.creator: Bianka Bakullari ✉, Wil M. P. van der Aalst
arxiv-2405-14435.description: Abstract Process mining traditionally relies on input consisting of low-level events that capture individual activities, such as filling out a form or processing a product. However, many of the complex problems inherent in processes, such as bottlenecks and compliance issues, extend beyond the scope of individual events and process instances.

arxiv-2406-19660.title: Chow rings and augmented Chow rings of uniform matroids and their q q -analogs
arxiv-2406-19660.creator: Hsin-Chieh Liao
arxiv-2406-19660.description: Abstract . We study the Hilbert series and the representations of 𝔖 n {\mathfrak{S}}_{n} and G ​ L n ​ ( 𝔽 q ) GL_{n}(\mathbb{F}_{q}) on the (augmented) Chow rings of uniform matroids U r , n U_{r,n} and q q -uniform matroids U r , n ​ ( q ) U_{r,n}(q) .

arxiv-2506-05361.title: Scalable Generation of Spatial Transcriptomics from Histology Images via Whole-Slide Flow Matching
arxiv-2506-05361.creator: Tinglin Huang, Tianyu Liu, Mehrtash Babadi, Wengong Jin, Rex Ying
arxiv-2506-05361.description: Abstract Spatial transcriptomics (ST) has emerged as a powerful technology for bridging histology imaging with gene expression profiling. However, its application has been limited by low throughput and the need for specialized experimental facilities. Prior works sought to predict ST from whole-slide histology images to accelerate this process, but they suffer from two major limitations.

arxiv-2507-05261.title: TokenShapley: Token Level Context Attribution with Shapley Value
arxiv-2507-05261.creator: Yingtai Xiao, Yuqing Zhu, Sirat Samyoun, Wanrong Zhang, Jiachen T. Wang, Jian Du
arxiv-2507-05261.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong capabilities in in-context learning, but verifying the correctness of their generated responses remains a challenge. Prior work has explored attribution at the sentence level, but these methods fall short when users seek attribution for specific keywords within the response, such as numbers, years, or names.

arxiv-2512-03148.title: Proof that Momentum Mixing Hatsugai Kohmoto equals the Twisted Hubbard Model
arxiv-2512-03148.creator: Yuting Bai 1 ,, Philip W. Phillips 1
arxiv-2512-03148.description: Abstract We prove formally that the momentum-mixing Hatsugai-Kohmoto model (MMHK) is the Hubbard model with a twist. With this result in tow, we rely on the proof of Watanabe’s that two models which differ by a twist must have the same bulk physics. Consequently, we have proven that MMHK=Hubbard in the charge sector.

arxiv-2601-13762.title: On the Optimal Layout of Two-Dimensional Lattices for Density Matrix Renormalization Group
arxiv-2601-13762.creator: Antonello Scardicchio
arxiv-2601-13762.description: Abstract For quantum spin models defined on a two-dimensional lattice, we look for the best numbering of the lattice sites (a layout) that, at fixed bond dimension and other parameters of the density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) algorithm, gives the lowest value of the variational energy, maximum entropy and truncation error.

arxiv-2606-31004.creator: Mert Onur Cakiroglu, Zhihe Lu, Mehmet Dalkilic, Hasan Kurban

plos-pone-0006675.creator: Jonathan Levy, Cyril Pernet, Sébastien Treserras et al.
plos-pone-0006675.description: PLOS ONE research article. Neuropsychological data about the forms of acquired reading impairment provide a strong basis for the theoretical framework of the dual-route cascade (DRC) model which is predictive of reading performance. However, lesions are often extensive and heterogeneous, thus making it dif

pmc-11509089.title: Euler Force-Driven Siphon Valve Control for Precise Sequential Release in Centrifugal Microfluidic Chips
pmc-11509089.creator: Yu Lu, Hao Shen, Guangyao Chen, Kaichao Yang, Jing Zhang, Liwei Xue, Jianzhen Ou, Liguo Chen, Lung-Ming Fu, Che-Hsin Lin
pmc-11509089.description: Controlling the fluids in centrifugal microfluidic chips for precise sequential release is critical for multi-step reactions and immunoassays. Currently, the traditional methods of liquid sequential release mainly rely on various types of microvalves, which face the problems of complex operation and high costs. Here, this work presents a method for driving liquid release using the Euler force.

pmc-11641332.title: Pleiotropic Associations with Alzheimer’s Disease and Physical Activity: Sex Differences and the Effects of Environment
pmc-11641332.creator: Yury Loika, Elena Loiko, Irina Culminskaya, Alexander M Kulminski, Hongjun (Harry) Fu
pmc-11641332.description: Physical activity (PA) is a modifiable factor in mitigating/preventing Alzheimer’s disease (AD). It is crucial to identify the conditions under which PA’s effects on AD risk would be beneficial. This study aims to gain insights into pleiotropic predisposition to AD and PA within and across sexes and environmental effects.

pmc-11674862.title: Updates on Inflammatory Molecular Pathways Mediated by ADAM17 in Autoimmunity
pmc-11674862.creator: Margherita Sisto, Sabrina Lisi
pmc-11674862.description: ADAM17 is a member of the disintegrin and metalloproteinase (ADAM) family of transmembrane proteases with immunoregulatory activity in multiple signaling pathways. The functional ADAM17 is involved in the shedding of the ectodomain characterizing many substrates belonging to growth factors, cytokines, receptors, and adhesion molecules.

pmc-12372352.title: Machine learning framework for investigating nano- and micro-scale particle diffusion in colonic mucus
pmc-12372352.creator: Marco Tjakra, Kristína Lidayová, Christophe Avenel, Christel AS Bergström, Shakhawath Hossain
pmc-12372352.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Biosimilar artificial mucus models that mimic native mucus facilitate efficient, lab-based drug diffusion studies, addressing the costly and challenging preclinical phase of drug development, especially for nano- and micro-scale particle-based colonic drug delivery. This study presents a machine-learning-driven framework that integrates microrheological features into diffusional fingerprinting to characterize nano- and micro-scale particle diffusion patterns in mucus and assess the effect of mucus microrheology on such movements.

pmc-12547822.title: Case-based surveillance of bacterial meningitis following MenAfrivac™ introduction at Sourô Sanou University Hospital, Bobo-Dioulasso, Burkina Faso, 2011-2021
pmc-12547822.creator: Zoungrana Jacques, Kabore D. Odilon, Tonde Issa, Ouattara Cheick Ahmed, Kiodima M.S. Odette, Muhigwa Merci, Diallo Ismael, Sawadogo Yacouba, Poda Armel, Ouedraogo Abdoul-Salam
pmc-12547822.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). pmc-12591915.title: Correlation between carotid Doppler ultrasound-derived parameters and cardiac output measurements: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12591915.creator: Feng Chen, Tao-Tao Peng, Hua-Wei Liu, Zhen-Xin Duan, Mi Yang, Hong Li
pmc-12591915.description: BackgroundThe utility of carotid Doppler ultrasound (CDU) as a noninvasive tool for cardiac output (CO) monitoring has been a subject of considerable debate. This meta-analysis was conducted to synthesize the available evidence and quantitatively assess the correlation between CDU-derived parameters and standard CO measurements.

pmc-12613776.title: Toxocarosis, toxoplasmosis and ocular dirofilariasis diagnosed in a polish farmer from Wielkopolska Voivodeship – a case description
pmc-12613776.creator: Łukasz Pielok, Rusłan Sałamatin, Joanna Swarcewicz, Krystyna Frąckowiak, Arleta Kowala-Piaskowska
pmc-12613776.description: IntroductionZoonotic diseases caused by different parasites are recently more frequently diagnosed in humans. Contact with domestic animals, mainly dogs and cats increases a risk for the infection. Toxocarosis and dirofilariasis have worldwide distribution. Parasitic infections in humans are diagnosed incidentally because health care providers has a little knowledge about them.

pmc-13046283.title: Estimating the causal effect of sleep duration on mental health in young adults: A meta-learner approach from physiological and nutritional perspectives
pmc-13046283.creator: Hak Gyun Oh, Jeong In Park, Ah Kyung Kim, Wah Wah Maw, Yerin Choi, Won Sang Lee
pmc-13046283.description: This study analyzes the causal effect of sleep duration on mental health among young adults using a meta-learner-based causal inference framework. Specifically, we applied a T-Learner model with Random Forest and XGBoost as the base learner to data from 1,405 individuals aged 19–34, drawn from the 2022–2023 Korea National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey.

pmc-13050231.title: Longitudinal Response to Epipharyngeal Abrasive Therapy (EAT) in Chronic Nasopharyngitis With Outcome Redefinition and Stratified Analysis by Tissue Type and Baseline Severity
pmc-13050231.creator: Ito Hirobumi
pmc-13050231.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to evaluate longitudinal changes in nasopharyngeal findings in patients undergoing epipharyngeal abrasive therapy (EAT) and to examine differences in treatment responsiveness according to macroscopic tissue type and baseline severity. In addition, outcome definitions were reconstructed using reproducible criteria based on EAT and bleeding scores, and factors associated with complete resolution were investigated.

pmc-13055360.title: One-step multiplex PCR assay for identification of Mycobacterium kansasii complex species
pmc-13055360.creator: Paulina Joanna Wałpuska, Zofia Bakuła, Katarzyna Rastawicka, Tomasz Jagielski
pmc-13055360.description: Currently, the Mycobacterium kansasii complex (MKC) species identification involves PCR amplification, followed by sequencing or digestion of the amplicons. The purpose of this study was to develop a one-step multiplex PCR assay allowing for a fast and accurate identification of MKC species. A total of 158 Mycobacterium sp.

pmc-13086849.title: Reconstructing the pharmacogenomic landscape of psychiatric medication metabolism in the Indian population
pmc-13086849.creator: Rajat Garg, SK Saxena, Vibha Singh, Amit Kumar, Sabreen Bashir, Hemender Singh, Nidhi Chahal, Indu Sharma, Varun Sharma
pmc-13086849.description: BackgroundWith the advent of genomic technologies, pharmacogenomics has evolved significantly. Such advancement facilitates comprehensive identification of common and rare alleles crucial for psychiatry treatments, especially in context of Indian psychiatric patients who are genetically diverse and for whom data is limited.

pmc-13171088.title: Liposarcoma With Extensive Necrosis Obscuring the Diagnosis in an HIV-Positive Patient: A Potential Diagnostic Pitfall
pmc-13171088.creator: Ali Khrayzat, Souha Kanj, Samer Deeba, Najla Fakhruddin
pmc-13171088.description: Liposarcoma is one of the most common soft tissue sarcomas in adults; however, its occurrence in patients with HIV is rarely reported. High-grade liposarcomas may demonstrate extensive necrosis, which can complicate pathologic evaluation, particularly in limited biopsy material, and may result in misinterpretation as an infectious or reactive process.

pmc-13236501.title: The effect of a 10-week swimming exercise program on emotional state in female sport sciences students
pmc-13236501.creator: Hande Yazıcıoğlu Çalışan, Yağmur Yıldız, Ladislav Batalik, Metin Yüceant
pmc-13236501.description: University students may experience a range of academic, social, and psychological stressors that can negatively affect emotional wellbeing. Although physical exercise is widely recognized as beneficial for mental health, evidence regarding the emotional effects of structured swimming programs in specific university subgroups remains limited.

pmc-13341580.title: Single-cell reconstruction of whole-brain efferent projections from mouse ventral posteromedial thalamus
pmc-13341580.creator: Heng-Zheng Wei, Yi-Yao Li, Hong-Yi Jia, Tian-Yu Zhao, Xiao Ren, Xin-Tong Qiu, Fu-Xing Zhang, Yun-Qing Li, Ming-Ming Zhang

pmc-13554351.title: Ethics as if Your Life Depended on It
pmc-13554351.creator: Joshua M. Pearce
pmc-13554351.description: PurposeThis Commentary examines whether current ethics approval systems for medical research, grounded in the Belmont Report's principles of respect for persons, beneficence, and justice, paradoxically result in preventable deaths by delaying patient access to experimental therapies and proposes a framework for democratizing ethics oversight while maintaining safety.
